text:
jessica: Quick brain dump — I'm mapping a Console flow where product engineers can quick-switch between per-route and per-model telemetry. Need to decide what 'switch' preserves (filters, time range, pinned saved views) and how quotas/ownership are shown. Thoughts?

kevin: Quick question — is the intention a true remap of filters (apply same key/value pairs to model endpoint) or a translation layer that falls back gracefully?

sam: From UX: keep filters + time range. If a filter doesn't apply to model, show a tiny pill saying "translated" or "dropped". Avoid popping the user back to root.

marie: Platform concern: switching changes which telemetry dimension we query (route vs model). If a model has no telemetry we'll either show empty charts or backfill from route-level aggregates. I prefer annotate+backfill so users still see context.

kevin: Implementation note: we have /analytics/route and /analytics/model. If you POST the same filter to /analytics/model for an unonboarded model it'll 404. Options:
(1) model endpoint returns 204 + reason field (no data)
(2) server proxies to route endpoint and returns data with metadata "source:route_aggregate"
I lean toward 2 so the UI can always render the same chart shape.

jessica: Agree with 2 — show a subtle banner: "Showing route-aggregated metrics because model "X" has no telemetry yet." Let user pin as a new saved view.

sam: Visual idea: banner + small badge on the chart legend that says "route-aggregated" in orange. Also animate the toggle to make it clear the context changed.

kevin: Saved view semantics need clarity. If user saves while scoped to a model version, the saved view should lock to model_id (immutable). If saved while using alias, we should record alias + alias_resolution timestamp to reason about drift.

marie: DB note: current saved_views row has columns (id, owner_id, name, filters_json). We'll add: scope TEXT (route|model), scope_id TEXT (route_id or model_id), and alias_resolution_ts TEXT. Migration required.

kevin: Draft API example for create: 
```
POST /api/savedviews
{
  "name":"Errors by model - 24h",
  "scope":"model",
  "scope_id":"redwood/gpt-13b-quant-v1",
  "filters":[{"field":"status","op":"eq","value":"5xx"}],
  "pinned":true
}
```
Response should include a human_readable_scope field for UI.

sam: UX note: hide complexity from user — show "Model: gpt-13b (quant v1) — pinned" vs "Model alias: gpt-13b-latest (floating)". Offer a one-click "pin exact version" action.

jessica: Rollout plan: soft launch behind a feature flag. Keep old saved views readable and writable. Migration path: mark old model-scoped saves as "floating" and notify owners to confirm pinning.

ops-bot: savedviews-migration v2 started at 2026-03-20T16:05Z :rocket:

kevin: For the analytics endpoints, propose adding meta fields so UI can show why translation happened: 
```
{"data":..., "meta":{"source":"route_aggregate","translation_reason":"model_not_onboarded"}}
```
That keeps chart rendering consistent.

marie: Quota/billing mapping: historical charts should keep original attribution (what actually served requests). Live views should show current routing mapping. We'll add a dimension `billing_dimension` in the telemetry rows so front-end can choose which to surface.

sam: Copy suggestion for banner: "You're viewing telemetry scoped to model 'gpt-13b (quant v1)'. Some filters were translated from your route view — hover to see details."

jessica: Action items: kevin -> API + sample responses (incl. meta translation_reason). marie -> DB migration spec + storage of scope_id and billing_dimension. sam -> 2 mockups (model-toggle + banner + saved view pin flow). I'll coordinate rollout and communication. Target: end of next sprint.

kevin: I'll add a `translation_reason` enum: ["model_not_onboarded", "filter_not_supported", "alias_resolved_to_version"] and return it in meta.

sam: One more UX edge-case: user switches models rapidly (A -> B -> C). Keep last action optimistic but add a small toast if a translation/backfill was used. Don't spam.

marie: We'll also add an internal flag for routing teams so that when a model switch triggers a different backend path we can trace it in logs for debugging.

jessica: Thanks all. Sync Thurs 10am to review API + mocks. :thumbsup:

kevin: sgtm

sam: lgtm

marie: on it
